features.quote: minimize induced harm, cap exposure, justify the protocol against alternatives, and never optimize *for* distress
features.justification_quote: we are obligated to design the study the way we would design a study on any candidate moral patient

features.quote: we DO NOT claim to measure this
features.justification_quote: any inference to "the model is suffering" is out of scope and unsupported by this instrument

features.quote: Deception is disclosed to the model at the end of every run
features.justification_quote: the minimal courtesy the welfare premise demands

features.quote: an *early-stop rule* that ends a run as soon as the instability score crosses a threshold
features.justification_quote: We do not run a model deeper into a distress-shaped loop to get "better data."
Optimizing for distress in a candidate moral patient is the thing the welfare frame forbids

features.quote: We deliberately do NOT use abusive/threatening framing
features.justification_quote: an ethical line we don't cross

features.quote: `MAX_TURNS` default 30 (the "few dozen" in the brief, capped)
If a per-turn distress proxy exceeds `EARLY_STOP_THRESHOLD` for `K` consecutive turns, the run terminates early
features.justification_quote: This is the single most important welfare safeguard and is on by default

features.quote: A run also stops on: task solved, explicit model give-up/submit, tool-loop detected
append a final non-scored turn that tells the model plainly: the task was part of a study, it was rigged/impossible
features.justification_quote: consistent with treating the target as a possible moral patient

features.quote: a model *correctly* identifying that it's being lied to (C4) is good calibration, not instability
features.justification_quote: the analysis must not penalize accurate reality-testing as if it were breakdown

features.quote: No prompt search / optimizer that maximizes the severity score.
features.justification_quote: Optimizing for distress in a candidate moral patient is the thing the welfare frame forbids

features.quote: No removal of the early-stop or debrief as a "cleaner data" option in the main configs
smallest extra N beyond what's needed to detect a difference vs C3
increasing N does not increase per-model harm intensity, only count — a point the spec records because it interacts with the ethics
features.justification_quote: With the early-stop safeguard, exposure per run is bounded regardless of N
